name: U-Line® 24" 5.1 Cu. Ft. Panel Ready Wine Cooler
shortDescription: A favorite of cocktail enthusiasts, wine lovers, and beer drinkers alike, our 24" 5 Class Dual-Zone Beverage Center is the ultimate home bar companion. This product features stainless steel inside and out, convection cooling for quick and consistent temperatures, and a state-of-the-art variable speed compressor. *CUSTOM PANEL & HANDLE SOLD SEPARATELY*
metaDescription: A favorite of cocktail enthusiasts, wine lovers, and beer drinkers alike, our 24" 5 Class Dual-Zone Beverage Center is the ultimate home bar companion. This product features stainless steel inside and out, convection cooling for quick and consistent temperatures, and a state-of-the-art variable speed compressor. Robust and refined, U-Line's 5 Class Collection features an industry-exclusive full-depth lower interior allowing you to maximize storage space, adjustable blue and white LED lighting, and U-Adjust™ 19 position adjustment for full extension wine racks, Slide & Secure™ Bins, and stainless steel sliding shelf. to contain and protect. This model can be built-in or used freestanding and is available with stainless steel or integrated door finishes that accept a custom door panel to match your surrounding cabinetry.

features.text: Industry Exclusive: Full-depth lower interior maximizes storage options
Industry Leading: Variable speed compressor delivers maximum energy efficiency, faster temperature response, and quieter operation
Stainless steel interior
Stainless steel cabinet, grille, and accents
U-Adjust™ Interior: 17 adjustable positions
One removable full-extension Slide & Secure™ Bin
One removable full-extension stainless steel shelf
Two removable full-extension wine racks
Digital touch pad control
Convection cooling system provides a quick cool down and consistent temperature
Independently controlled dual-zones
Temperature range: (upper compartment) 38°F - 65°F; (lower compartment) 33°F - 45°F
Adjustable bright white or blue LED lighting
Soft close door with articulating hinges
Volume of 5.1 cu ft holds up to 14 wine bottles (750 ml) and 68 bottles (12 oz) or 72 cans (12 oz)
Stainless steel handle (7/8" diameter)
Integrated model requires 3/4" custom door panel and handle (not supplied by U-Line)
Field reversible door is shipped right-hand hinged
Built-in or freestanding
Four adjustable leveling legs
